verdict.rationale: bizfile's own User Access feature lets an entity control who is authorized to submit online filings on its behalf, and it becomes mandatory for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. That is a sanctioned delegation rail. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and never says how outside providers are granted, scoped or revoked. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that third-party providers or registered agents can be designated, details of the delegation workflow and permission scopes, programmatic or bulk-provider access, and independent corroboration.
